sections.title: 1. Document Information & Governance Baseline
sections.body:
**Document Type:** User Stories Specification (Agile Backlog)
**Project Title:** Hospital Management System
**Specification Version:** v2.0
**Document Status:** PENDING APPROVAL
**Authoring Engine:** REFYNE AI Requirement Engineering Pipeline

This specification defines the decomposed, verifiable user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirement traceability matrix for **Hospital Management System**. All stories are grounded strictly in the source requirements.

sections.title: 2. Source Requirement Summary & Scope Baseline
sections.body:
The source specification establishes a centralized operational platform covering comprehensive clinical, diagnostic, pharmaceutical, financial, and administrative capabilities.

**Key Scope Areas Extracted from Source:**
• **REQ-PAT-01 (Patient Management)**: Patient registration — *Register new patients with demographic details, contact info, and emergency contacts.*
• **REQ-PAT-02 (Patient Management)**: Patient profile management — *Manage and update existing patient demographic and contact information.*
• **REQ-PAT-03 (Patient Management)**: Patient portal profile & history access — *Provide patient self-service portal access to view appointments, medical history, prescriptions, and bills.*
• **REQ-APT-01 (Appointment Scheduling)**: Doctor availability scheduling — *Configure doctor consultation schedules and working hours to prevent double-booking.*
• **REQ-APT-02 (Appointment Scheduling)**: Appointment booking — *Schedule outpatient appointments for patients against available doctor slots.*
• **REQ-APT-03 (Appointment Scheduling)**: Doctor appointment dashboard — *Provide clinical dashboards for doctors to view upcoming appointment schedules.*
• **REQ-APT-04 (Queue Management)**: OPD queue & token management — *Issue sequential queue tokens upon arrival and manage live waiting lists for consultation rooms.*
• **REQ-IPD-01 (Inpatient Management)**: Inpatient admission request & recording — *Record formal inpatient admissions with admitting diagnosis, admitting doctor, and reasons.*
• **REQ-IPD-02 (Inpatient Management)**: Bed and ward allocation — *Map hospital rooms/wards visually and allocate available beds to admitted patients.*
• **REQ-IPD-03 (Inpatient Management)**: Patient bed/ward transfer — *Transfer admitted patients between beds or wards with timestamped history and differential rate tracking.*
• **REQ-IPD-04 (Inpatient Management)**: Patient clinical discharge & summary — *Process clinical discharge, generate discharge summaries, and trigger billing reconciliation.*
• **REQ-EMR-01 (Clinical & EMR)**: Clinical notes & diagnosis documentation — *Record patient chief complaints, clinical observations, diagnoses, and treatment plans.*
• **REQ-EMR-02 (Clinical & EMR)**: Allergy & adverse reaction management — *Document and prominently flag drug, food, and environmental allergies to prevent contraindicated orders.*
• **REQ-EMR-03 (Clinical & EMR)**: Vital signs & nursing notes — *Record routine vitals (BP, pulse, temp, SpO2) and nursing care notes into patient charts.*
• **REQ-EMR-04 (Clinical & EMR)**: Integrated treatment history timeline — *Maintain consolidated chronological history of consultations, procedures, lab findings, and medications.*
• *... and 18 additional functional & governance requirements extracted from source.*

sections.title: 3. Authorized System Personas & Role Mappings
sections.body:
The system enforces role-based access for the following authorized personas explicitly identified in the source requirements:

• **Receptionist**: Patient registration, Appointment scheduling, OPD Queue token issuance, Front-desk check-in
• **Doctor**: Consultations, Diagnosis, Prescription orders, Clinical notes, Lab requests, Discharge clearance
• **Nurse**: Vital signs recording, Nursing notes, Inpatient care tracking, Ward transfer assistance
• **Pharmacist**: Prescription verification, Medicine dispensing, Stock management, Expiry alerts
• **Lab Technician**: Sample collection, Diagnostic test entry, Result validation, Lab report publishing
• **Accountant**: Outpatient billing, Inpatient final billing, Insurance claims, Receipts, Hospital expenses
• **Admin**: User management, RBAC configuration, Staff directory, Procurement approvals, Audit log reviews, Backups
• **Patient**: Self-service portal access, Viewing appointments, Viewing prescriptions, Viewing lab reports, Viewing invoices

sections.title: 4. Epic Decomposition & Module Breakdown
sections.body:
The backlog is partitioned into the following functional Epics:

• **Epic: Appointment Scheduling** (3 User Stories)
• **Epic: Audit & Compliance** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Billing & Financials** (5 User Stories)
• **Epic: Clinical & EMR** (4 User Stories)
• **Epic: Dashboards & Reporting** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Inpatient Management** (4 User Stories)
• **Epic: Laboratory** (3 User Stories)
• **Epic: Patient Management** (2 User Stories)
• **Epic: Patient Portal** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Pharmacy** (4 User Stories)
• **Epic: Procurement & Inventory** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Queue Management** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Security & Access** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Staff Management** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: System Reliability** (1 User Stories)

sections.title: 5. User Stories Matrix & Detailed Specifications
table: As a Receptionist, I want to register a new patient with their full demographic and emergency contact details, so that a unique medical record is established in the hospital directory.
Unique patient identification prevents duplicate files and speeds up all future encounters.
As a Receptionist, I want to update patient demographic and contact information, so that patient records remain accurate and up to date.
Accurate patient contact information ensures dependable appointment notifications and communications.
As a Patient, I want to log into my self-service portal to view my appointments, prescriptions, lab reports, and billing history, so that I can manage my healthcare journey transparently.
Patient empowerment reduces front-desk phone inquiries and improves treatment adherence.
As a Doctor, I want to configure my consultation working hours, slot durations, and planned leaves, so that receptionists and patients only book available consultation slots.
Prevents clinical scheduling conflicts and double-booking.
As a Receptionist, I want to schedule outpatient appointments by selecting an available doctor time slot, so that patient visits are planned efficiently.
Minimizes patient waiting room congestion through scheduled consultation intervals.
As a Doctor, I want to view my daily appointment schedule on a clinical dashboard, so that I can organize my consultation workflow and prepare for arriving patients.
Provides doctors with actionable visibility of upcoming patient visits.
As a Receptionist, I want to check in arriving patients and generate sequential OPD queue tokens, so that outpatient consultation rooms maintain an orderly physical queue.
Eliminates front-desk confusion and provides patients with transparent waiting queue positions.
As a Doctor, I want to initiate a formal inpatient admission order with admitting diagnosis and clinical rationale, so that outpatients or emergency cases are transitioned into ward care.
Formalizes inpatient admission accountability and initiates inpatient clinical workflows.
As a Nurse, I want to view real-time ward bed occupancy and assign an available bed to an admitted patient, so that patients are accommodated in appropriate care units.
Optimizes hospital bed utilization and ensures proper clinical ward placement.
As a Nurse, I want to record patient bed or ward transfers with transfer reasons and timestamps, so that patient physical location and differential room rates are tracked accurately.
Maintains accurate clinical location tracking and differential room billing calculations.
As a Doctor, I want to authorize clinical discharge and author a structured discharge summary, so that inpatient treatment is formally closed and final billing can proceed.
Ensures proper medical sign-off and patient handover instructions prior to discharge.
As a Doctor, I want to record chief complaints, clinical observations, diagnoses, and treatment plans during consultations, so that a complete encounter record is documented.
Maintains an accurate, legally compliant medical record for every clinical visit.
As a Doctor, I want to record known patient allergies and have the system warn me if I prescribe a contraindicated drug, so that adverse drug reactions are prevented.
Eliminates preventable prescription errors and protects patient safety.
As a Nurse, I want to record patient vital signs (BP, heart rate, temperature, SpO2) and nursing notes, so that patient physiological status is tracked continuously.
Enables timely detection of patient clinical deterioration.
As a Doctor, I want to view an integrated chronological timeline of all past consultations, admissions, lab results, and medications, so that I have complete historical context.
Provides longitudinal medical context for accurate clinical decision-making.
As a Doctor, I want to order diagnostic laboratory tests from the clinical encounter screen, so that the laboratory receives structured diagnostic test orders.
Eliminates paper lab slips and accelerates diagnostic turnaround times.
As a Lab Technician, I want to record specimen collection and enter test findings against standard reference ranges, so that diagnostic results are validated.
Ensures laboratory findings are accurately recorded and abnormal values are flagged.
As a Lab Technician, I want to publish finalized diagnostic lab reports to the patient chart and portal, so that physicians and patients can review test outcomes.
Provides immediate electronic access to verified diagnostic findings.
As a Pharmacist, I want to view electronic prescriptions and dispense prescribed medications with verified dosage instructions, so that patients receive correct medications.
Eliminates prescription transcription errors and verifies medication safety.
As a Pharmacist, I want medicine inventory stock quantities to automatically decrement upon dispensing, so that stock records reflect live availability.
Prevents inventory discrepancies and manual stock ledger reconciliations.
As a Pharmacist, I want to track medicine batch numbers and expiration dates with automated expiry warnings, so that expired medicines are never dispensed.
Protects patient health by enforcing First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) dispensing rules.
As a Pharmacist, I want to receive automated low-stock threshold alerts and generate replenishment lists, so that essential medicines never stock out.
Guarantees continuous availability of life-saving pharmaceutical supplies.
As an Accountant, I want to generate itemized invoices for outpatient consultations, lab tests, and pharmacy orders, so that outpatient revenue is billed accurately.
Ensures rapid, transparent billing collection at outpatient points of service.
As an Accountant, I want to consolidate room stay charges, doctor rounds, procedures, tests, and medications into a final inpatient invoice upon discharge, so that revenue is reconciled.
Eliminates unbilled inpatient hospital services upon patient discharge.
As an Accountant, I want to record patient insurance policy details, verify coverage, and track insurance claim settlements, so that co-pays and insurance balances are split correctly.
Accelerates insurance claim reimbursement and clarifies patient out-of-pocket costs.
As an Accountant, I want to generate official payment receipts and review past billing transaction histories, so that financial transactions are auditable.
Provides patients with proof of payment and maintains auditable transaction records.
As an Accountant, I want to record and categorize hospital operational expenses (utilities, supplier bills, maintenance), so that hospital cash outflows are tracked.
Provides comprehensive financial oversight over hospital operational expenses.
As an Admin, I want to manage staff profiles, department assignments, and job designations, so that hospital human resource records are organized.
Establishes clean organizational directory for clinical and administrative staff.
As an Admin, I want to track non-pharmacy hospital equipment, medical consumables, and purchase requisitions, so that hospital equipment is maintained.
Ensures non-pharmacy consumables and biomedical equipment are replenished on schedule.
As an Admin, I want to enforce role-based access control, secure authentication, password encryption, and session management, so that medical and financial records are protected.
Protects sensitive patient data and enforces least-privilege security principles.
As an Admin, I want to review comprehensive, immutable audit logs of user logins, medical record views, prescriptions, and billing actions, so that hospital activities are accountable.
Enforces institutional accountability and satisfies regulatory compliance standards.
As an Admin, I want the system to enforce data validation, automated error logging, and regular database backups, so that system stability and data integrity are maintained.
Guarantees platform resilience, data preservation, and rapid disaster recovery.
As an Admin, I want to view executive dashboards, generate hospital reports, search across modules, and receive alert notifications, so that management has actionable operational intelligence.
Provides executive visibility across clinical occupancy, operational revenue, and hospital throughput.
sections.body:
### Detailed Acceptance Criteria & Story Specifications **US-PAT-01: As a Receptionist, I want to register a new patient with their full demographic and emergency contact details, so that a unique medical record is established in the hospital directory.**
• **Epic:** Patient Management | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PAT-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Form captures full name, DOB, gender, phone number, address, and primary emergency contact.
  AC2: System checks for duplicate profiles matching phone number or national identity.
  AC3: System assigns a unique, sequential, permanent Patient ID upon successful registration.
  AC4: The newly registered patient record is immediately searchable across all hospital modules.

**US-PAT-02: As a Receptionist, I want to update patient demographic and contact information, so that patient records remain accurate and up to date.**
• **Epic:** Patient Management | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PAT-02` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Receptionist can search by Patient ID or name to open the editable demographic profile.
  AC2: Contact phone and address updates are validated for format integrity before saving.
  AC3: All profile edits are timestamped and attributed to the editing receptionist account.

**US-PAT-03: As a Patient, I want to log into my self-service portal to view my appointments, prescriptions, lab reports, and billing history, so that I can manage my healthcare journey transparently.**
• **Epic:** Patient Portal | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PAT-03` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01, US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Patient logs in securely using registered phone/email and password credentials.
  AC2: Portal displays categorized tabs for Appointments, Prescriptions, Lab Reports, and Invoices.
  AC3: Reports and invoices can be viewed online or downloaded as PDF documents.

**US-APT-01: As a Doctor, I want to configure my consultation working hours, slot durations, and planned leaves, so that receptionists and patients only book available consultation slots.**
• **Epic:** Appointment Scheduling | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-APT-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Doctor can define recurring weekly shift timings and consultation slot lengths (e.g. 15 mins).
  AC2: Doctor can block specific dates/times for surgeries, rounds, or planned leave.
  AC3: Schedule updates instantly adjust the available booking calendar across the system.

**US-APT-02: As a Receptionist, I want to schedule outpatient appointments by selecting an available doctor time slot, so that patient visits are planned efficiently.**
• **Epic:** Appointment Scheduling | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-APT-02` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01, US-APT-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: System presents open time slots based on doctor availability schedules.
  AC2: Booking captures patient ID, doctor ID, consultation reason, and booking timestamp.
  AC3: System locks the slot and prevents double-booking the same physician at the same time.

**US-APT-03: As a Doctor, I want to view my daily appointment schedule on a clinical dashboard, so that I can organize my consultation workflow and prepare for arriving patients.**
• **Epic:** Appointment Scheduling | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-APT-03` | **Dependencies:** `US-APT-02`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Dashboard lists all scheduled patients chronologically for the selected date.
  AC2: Displays patient name, age, appointment time, and arrival status (Booked / Checked-In).
  AC3: Doctor can click on any patient row to open their clinical encounter chart.

**US-QUE-01: As a Receptionist, I want to check in arriving patients and generate sequential OPD queue tokens, so that outpatient consultation rooms maintain an orderly physical queue.**
• **Epic:** Queue Management | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-APT-04` | **Dependencies:** `US-APT-02`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Check-in assigns a sequential token number (e.g. T-01, T-02) tied to the assigned doctor.
  AC2: System updates queue status: 'Waiting' → 'Called' → 'In Consultation' → 'Completed'.
  AC3: Waiting room screens display active token calls in real time.

**US-IPD-01: As a Doctor, I want to initiate a formal inpatient admission order with admitting diagnosis and clinical rationale, so that outpatients or emergency cases are transitioned into ward care.**
• **Epic:** Inpatient Management | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-IPD-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01, US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Admission form captures admitting doctor, initial diagnosis, admission category, and priority.
  AC2: Patient status updates to 'Admitted' in the central registry.
  AC3: System triggers a bed allocation task to the inpatient ward desk.

**US-IPD-02: As a Nurse, I want to view real-time ward bed occupancy and assign an available bed to an admitted patient, so that patients are accommodated in appropriate care units.**
• **Epic:** Inpatient Management | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-IPD-02` | **Dependencies:** `US-IPD-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: System displays visual ward layout with bed statuses: 'Available', 'Occupied', 'Cleaning'.
  AC2: System prevents assigning occupied or uncleaned beds.
  AC3: Selected bed is reserved and linked to the active inpatient admission record.

**US-IPD-03: As a Nurse, I want to record patient bed or ward transfers with transfer reasons and timestamps, so that patient physical location and differential room rates are tracked accurately.**
• **Epic:** Inpatient Management | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-IPD-03` | **Dependencies:** `US-IPD-02`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Form accepts origin bed, destination bed, transfer reason, and transfer timestamp.
  AC2: Origin bed is released to 'Cleaning' and destination bed marked 'Occupied'.
  AC3: Transfer history is logged in the admission chart for billing calculation.

**US-IPD-04: As a Doctor, I want to authorize clinical discharge and author a structured discharge summary, so that inpatient treatment is formally closed and final billing can proceed.**
• **Epic:** Inpatient Management | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-IPD-04` | **Dependencies:** `US-IPD-01, US-IPD-02`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Doctor enters final diagnosis, clinical course, condition at discharge, and follow-up advice.
  AC2: Bed status transitions to vacated and queued for sanitization.
  AC3: System locks clinical ordering and notifies the billing desk for final reconciliation.

**US-EMR-01: As a Doctor, I want to record chief complaints, clinical observations, diagnoses, and treatment plans during consultations, so that a complete encounter record is documented.**
• **Epic:** Clinical & EMR | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-EMR-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01, US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Clinical form captures chief complaints, history of present illness, and ICD diagnoses.
  AC2: Clinical notes are permanently timestamped and digitally attributed to the doctor.
  AC3: Saved encounter notes are immediately accessible in the patient's EMR timeline.

**US-EMR-02: As a Doctor, I want to record known patient allergies and have the system warn me if I prescribe a contraindicated drug, so that adverse drug reactions are prevented.**
• **Epic:** Clinical & EMR | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-EMR-02` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Captures allergen name, reaction severity (Mild, Moderate, Severe), and date observed.
  AC2: Displays high-visibility allergy badge on the patient chart header.
  AC3: System triggers an audible/visual warning if a prescribed drug conflicts with documented allergies.

**US-EMR-03: As a Nurse, I want to record patient vital signs (BP, heart rate, temperature, SpO2) and nursing notes, so that patient physiological status is tracked continuously.**
• **Epic:** Clinical & EMR | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-EMR-03` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Form accepts standard numeric vital readings for BP, Pulse, Temperature, SpO2, and Resp Rate.
  AC2: Readings outside standard physiological ranges are highlighted in red.
  AC3: Chronological vitals trend chart is rendered in the patient chart.

**US-EMR-04: As a Doctor, I want to view an integrated chronological timeline of all past consultations, admissions, lab results, and medications, so that I have complete historical context.**
• **Epic:** Clinical & EMR | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-EMR-04` | **Dependencies:** `US-EMR-01, US-EMR-03`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Timeline displays chronological visits, admissions, procedures, and tests.
  AC2: Quick filters allow narrowing history by encounter type, date range, or specialty.
  AC3: Past clinical entries are strictly read-only to preserve legal integrity.

**US-LAB-01: As a Doctor, I want to order diagnostic laboratory tests from the clinical encounter screen, so that the laboratory receives structured diagnostic test orders.**
• **Epic:** Laboratory | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-LAB-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-EMR-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Doctor selects investigations from the hospital's standardized laboratory test catalog.
  AC2: Order captures clinical indication, urgency (Routine / Stat), and ordering physician ID.
  AC3: Order is dispatched instantly to the laboratory technician worklist.

**US-LAB-02: As a Lab Technician, I want to record specimen collection and enter test findings against standard reference ranges, so that diagnostic results are validated.**
• **Epic:** Laboratory | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-LAB-02` | **Dependencies:** `US-LAB-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Technician logs specimen barcode ID, collection timestamp, and sample condition.
  AC2: Form accepts quantitative findings and automatically highlights out-of-range values.
  AC3: Result entry requires technician sign-off before report generation.

**US-LAB-03: As a Lab Technician, I want to publish finalized diagnostic lab reports to the patient chart and portal, so that physicians and patients can review test outcomes.**
• **Epic:** Laboratory | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-LAB-03` | **Dependencies:** `US-LAB-02`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Lab technician signs off and finalizes the diagnostic report.
  AC2: Finalized report is published immediately to the patient chart and patient portal.
  AC3: System generates printable PDF lab reports with hospital letterhead and reference ranges.

**US-PHM-01: As a Pharmacist, I want to view electronic prescriptions and dispense prescribed medications with verified dosage instructions, so that patients receive correct medications.**
• **Epic:** Pharmacy | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PHARM-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-EMR-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Pharmacist queue displays pending prescriptions with patient name, medicine, dosage, and duration.
  AC2: Pharmacist verifies dosage and flags any dispensing notes.
  AC3: Confirming dispensing updates prescription status to 'Dispensed'.

**US-PHM-02: As a Pharmacist, I want medicine inventory stock quantities to automatically decrement upon dispensing, so that stock records reflect live availability.**
• **Epic:** Pharmacy | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PHARM-02` | **Dependencies:** `US-PHM-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Dispensing confirmation immediately deducts dispensed unit counts from the inventory database.
  AC2: System blocks dispensing if requested count exceeds available physical stock.
  AC3: Every stock decrement is logged with timestamp, prescription ID, and pharmacist ID.

**US-PHM-03: As a Pharmacist, I want to track medicine batch numbers and expiration dates with automated expiry warnings, so that expired medicines are never dispensed.**
• **Epic:** Pharmacy | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PHARM-03` | **Dependencies:** `US-PHM-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Stock records track batch number, manufacturing date, and expiry date for each drug.
  AC2: Dashboard displays active alerts for batches expiring within 30, 60, and 90 days.
  AC3: System strictly blocks selection of expired batches during prescription fulfillment.

**US-PHM-04: As a Pharmacist, I want to receive automated low-stock threshold alerts and generate replenishment lists, so that essential medicines never stock out.**
• **Epic:** Pharmacy | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PHARM-04` | **Dependencies:** `US-PHM-02`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Minimum reorder threshold quantities can be configured per medicine.
  AC2: System alerts pharmacist when stock dips below minimum reorder level.
  AC3: Generates exportable purchase requisition lists for depleted inventory items.

**US-BIL-01: As an Accountant, I want to generate itemized invoices for outpatient consultations, lab tests, and pharmacy orders, so that outpatient revenue is billed accurately.**
• **Epic:** Billing & Financials | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-BIL-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-PAT-01, US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: System auto-populates billing line items from consultation fees, lab orders, and pharmacy issues.
  AC2: Accountant can apply authorized discounts and select payment modes (Cash / Card / Digital).
  AC3: Invoice generation updates balance due and issues an official invoice number.

**US-BIL-02: As an Accountant, I want to consolidate room stay charges, doctor rounds, procedures, tests, and medications into a final inpatient invoice upon discharge, so that revenue is reconciled.**
• **Epic:** Billing & Financials | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-BIL-02` | **Dependencies:** `US-IPD-04, US-BIL-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Calculates room/bed charges based on stay duration and bed transfer history.
  AC2: Aggregates all clinical procedures, investigations, nursing charges, and medications.
  AC3: Reconciles advance deposits against final total balance before discharge clearance.

**US-BIL-03: As an Accountant, I want to record patient insurance policy details, verify coverage, and track insurance claim settlements, so that co-pays and insurance balances are split correctly.**
• **Epic:** Billing & Financials | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-BIL-03` | **Dependencies:** `US-BIL-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Form captures insurance provider, policy number, pre-authorization code, and co-pay %.
  AC2: System splits final invoice into patient payable portion and insurer claim amount.
  AC3: Tracks claim status transitions: 'Submitted' → 'Approved' → 'Settled' → 'Rejected'.

**US-BIL-04: As an Accountant, I want to generate official payment receipts and review past billing transaction histories, so that financial transactions are auditable.**
• **Epic:** Billing & Financials | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-BIL-04` | **Dependencies:** `US-BIL-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: System prints official receipt with receipt number, payment mode, tax breakdown, and cashier name.
  AC2: Patients can view and download all past receipts from the patient portal.
  AC3: Maintains immutable payment transaction logs that cannot be modified.

**US-BIL-05: As an Accountant, I want to record and categorize hospital operational expenses (utilities, supplier bills, maintenance), so that hospital cash outflows are tracked.**
• **Epic:** Billing & Financials | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-BIL-05` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Form records expense category, vendor name, invoice reference, payment date, and amount.
  AC2: Requires administrative approval for expense vouchers exceeding threshold limits.
  AC3: Generates monthly hospital operational expenditure summary reports.

**US-STF-01: As an Admin, I want to manage staff profiles, department assignments, and job designations, so that hospital human resource records are organized.**
• **Epic:** Staff Management | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-STF-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Admin can create, view, update, and deactivate employee records.
  AC2: Assigns staff members to clinical, nursing, pharmacy, lab, or administrative departments.
  AC3: Staff directory is searchable by name, designation, and department.

**US-PRC-01: As an Admin, I want to track non-pharmacy hospital equipment, medical consumables, and purchase requisitions, so that hospital equipment is maintained.**
• **Epic:** Procurement & Inventory | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-PRC-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Tracks hospital physical assets, serial numbers, maintenance schedules, and consumable levels.
  AC2: Department heads can submit purchase requests for supplies.
  AC3: Admin can review and approve purchase orders.

**US-SEC-01: As an Admin, I want to enforce role-based access control, secure authentication, password encryption, and session management, so that medical and financial records are protected.**
• **Epic:** Security & Access | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-SEC-01` | **Dependencies:** `None (Independent)`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: System enforces role permissions for Admin, Doctor, Nurse, Receptionist, Pharmacist, Lab Tech, Accountant, and Patient.
  AC2: Passwords are encrypted using modern hashing algorithms and authenticated with secure session tokens.
  AC3: Unauthorized API requests are blocked with HTTP 401/403 status codes.

**US-AUD-01: As an Admin, I want to review comprehensive, immutable audit logs of user logins, medical record views, prescriptions, and billing actions, so that hospital activities are accountable.**
• **Epic:** Audit & Compliance | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-AUD-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: System logs timestamp, user ID, role, action type, resource ID, and client IP address.
  AC2: Audit logs are append-only and protected against modification or deletion.
  AC3: Admin can filter audit logs by date range, user, action, and module.

**US-SYS-01: As an Admin, I want the system to enforce data validation, automated error logging, and regular database backups, so that system stability and data integrity are maintained.**
• **Epic:** System Reliability | **Priority:** High | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-SYS-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Server-side validation rejects malformed payloads with descriptive error responses.
  AC2: Unhandled exceptions are logged with stack traces for engineering diagnosis.
  AC3: Automated daily database backup routines execute and verify archive integrity.

**US-DSH-01: As an Admin, I want to view executive dashboards, generate hospital reports, search across modules, and receive alert notifications, so that management has actionable operational intelligence.**
• **Epic:** Dashboards & Reporting | **Priority:** Medium | **Source Requirement:** `REQ-DSH-01` | **Dependencies:** `US-SEC-01, US-PAT-01, US-BIL-01`
• **Acceptance Criteria:**
  AC1: Executive dashboard visualizes bed occupancy rates, revenue metrics, and patient visit volumes.
  AC2: Global search allows multi-criteria filtering across patients, staff, invoices, and lab tests.
  AC3: Automated notifications alert users to appointment bookings, critical lab findings, and stock thresholds.

sections.title: 6. End-to-End Workflow Coverage
sections.body:
The user stories fully encompass the complete multi-step workflows defined in the source document:

**Outpatient (OPD) Consultation Workflow:**
`Patient Registration → Appointment Scheduling → OPD Queue Token → Doctor Consultation → Diagnosis & Prescriptions → Lab / Pharmacy Orders → Outpatient Billing → Follow-up`

**Inpatient (IPD) Admission-to-Discharge Workflow:**
`Inpatient Admission Request → Bed & Ward Allocation → Clinical Treatment & Vitals Tracking → Diagnostic Investigations → Discharge Clearance & Summary → Final Billing Reconciliation`

sections.title: 7. Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)
sections.body: This matrix provides 100% bidirectional traceability from original source requirements to executable user stories.

sections.title: 8. Dependency-Derived Release & Sprint Slicing
sections.body:
**Release 1: Outpatient Care, Doctor Availability & Core EMR Foundation**
• **Objective:** Establish patient onboarding, front-desk scheduling, OPD queues, vital signs, allergies, and core doctor notes.
• **User Stories:** US-PAT-01, US-PAT-02, US-PAT-03, US-APT-01, US-APT-02, US-APT-03, US-QUE-01, US-EMR-01, US-EMR-02, US-EMR-03, US-SEC-01

**Release 2: Inpatient (IPD) Lifecycle, Diagnostic Lab & Pharmacy Operations**
• **Objective:** Deploy inpatient admission-to-discharge, bed allocations, transfers, lab ordering/results, and pharmacy stock decrements.
• **User Stories:** US-IPD-01, US-IPD-02, US-IPD-03, US-IPD-04, US-LAB-01, US-LAB-02, US-LAB-03, US-PHM-01, US-PHM-02, US-PHM-03, US-PHM-04

**Release 3: Financials, Expenses, Hospital Administration & Governance**
• **Objective:** Complete billing reconciliation, insurance claims, expenses, staff management, general procurement, and audit logs.
• **User Stories:** US-EMR-04, US-BIL-01, US-BIL-02, US-BIL-03, US-BIL-04, US-BIL-05, US-STF-01, US-PRC-01, US-AUD-01, US-SYS-01, US-DSH-01

sections.title: 9. Technical Dependencies & Cross-Module Constraints
sections.body:
• **Authentication Gate:** User authentication and role-based access control (US-SEC-01) must be established prior to granting role-specific access.
• **Clinical Encounter Binding:** Prescription and lab orders require an active consultation encounter or inpatient admission record.
• **Financial Invoicing:** Inpatient final billing requires completed discharge clearance from the attending doctor.
• **Inventory Deductions:** Medicine dispensing strictly validates on-hand batch quantities before decrementing stock.

sections.title: 10. Open Items & Stakeholder Clarifications
sections.body:
• **Third-Party Payment Gateway Providers:** Identify specific payment gateway vendors (e.g. Stripe, Razorpay) for digital payment processing.
• **External Insurance Clearinghouses:** Determine whether EDI/electronic insurance claim clearinghouse integration is required in subsequent phases.
• **Hardware Barcode Scanners:** Confirm barcode/QR scanner device protocols for pharmacy inventory batch scanning.

stories.user_story: As a Receptionist, I want to register a new patient with their full demographic and emergency contact details, so that a unique medical record is established in the hospital directory.
stories.capability: register a new patient with their full demographic and emergency contact details
stories.business_value: Unique patient identification prevents duplicate files and speeds up all future encounters.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Form captures full name, DOB, gender, phone number, address, and primary emergency contact.
AC2: System checks for duplicate profiles matching phone number or national identity.
AC3: System assigns a unique, sequential, permanent Patient ID upon successful registration.
AC4: The newly registered patient record is immediately searchable across all hospital modules.

stories.user_story: As a Receptionist, I want to update patient demographic and contact information, so that patient records remain accurate and up to date.
stories.capability: update patient demographic and contact information
stories.business_value: Accurate patient contact information ensures dependable appointment notifications and communications.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Receptionist can search by Patient ID or name to open the editable demographic profile.
AC2: Contact phone and address updates are validated for format integrity before saving.
AC3: All profile edits are timestamped and attributed to the editing receptionist account.

stories.user_story: As a Patient, I want to log into my self-service portal to view my appointments, prescriptions, lab reports, and billing history, so that I can manage my healthcare journey transparently.
stories.capability: log into my self-service portal to view my appointments, prescriptions, lab reports, and billing history
stories.business_value: Patient empowerment reduces front-desk phone inquiries and improves treatment adherence.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Patient logs in securely using registered phone/email and password credentials.
AC2: Portal displays categorized tabs for Appointments, Prescriptions, Lab Reports, and Invoices.
AC3: Reports and invoices can be viewed online or downloaded as PDF documents.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to configure my consultation working hours, slot durations, and planned leaves, so that receptionists and patients only book available consultation slots.
stories.capability: configure my consultation working hours, slot durations, and planned leaves
stories.business_value: Prevents clinical scheduling conflicts and double-booking.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Doctor can define recurring weekly shift timings and consultation slot lengths (e.g. 15 mins).
AC2: Doctor can block specific dates/times for surgeries, rounds, or planned leave.
AC3: Schedule updates instantly adjust the available booking calendar across the system.

stories.user_story: As a Receptionist, I want to schedule outpatient appointments by selecting an available doctor time slot, so that patient visits are planned efficiently.
stories.capability: schedule outpatient appointments by selecting an available doctor time slot
stories.business_value: Minimizes patient waiting room congestion through scheduled consultation intervals.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: System presents open time slots based on doctor availability schedules.
AC2: Booking captures patient ID, doctor ID, consultation reason, and booking timestamp.
AC3: System locks the slot and prevents double-booking the same physician at the same time.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to view my daily appointment schedule on a clinical dashboard, so that I can organize my consultation workflow and prepare for arriving patients.
stories.capability: view my daily appointment schedule on a clinical dashboard
stories.business_value: Provides doctors with actionable visibility of upcoming patient visits.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Dashboard lists all scheduled patients chronologically for the selected date.
AC2: Displays patient name, age, appointment time, and arrival status (Booked / Checked-In).
AC3: Doctor can click on any patient row to open their clinical encounter chart.

stories.user_story: As a Receptionist, I want to check in arriving patients and generate sequential OPD queue tokens, so that outpatient consultation rooms maintain an orderly physical queue.
stories.capability: check in arriving patients and generate sequential OPD queue tokens
stories.business_value: Eliminates front-desk confusion and provides patients with transparent waiting queue positions.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Check-in assigns a sequential token number (e.g. T-01, T-02) tied to the assigned doctor.
AC2: System updates queue status: 'Waiting' → 'Called' → 'In Consultation' → 'Completed'.
AC3: Waiting room screens display active token calls in real time.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to initiate a formal inpatient admission order with admitting diagnosis and clinical rationale, so that outpatients or emergency cases are transitioned into ward care.
stories.capability: initiate a formal inpatient admission order with admitting diagnosis and clinical rationale
stories.business_value: Formalizes inpatient admission accountability and initiates inpatient clinical workflows.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Admission form captures admitting doctor, initial diagnosis, admission category, and priority.
AC2: Patient status updates to 'Admitted' in the central registry.
AC3: System triggers a bed allocation task to the inpatient ward desk.

stories.user_story: As a Nurse, I want to view real-time ward bed occupancy and assign an available bed to an admitted patient, so that patients are accommodated in appropriate care units.
stories.capability: view real-time ward bed occupancy and assign an available bed to an admitted patient
stories.business_value: Optimizes hospital bed utilization and ensures proper clinical ward placement.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: System displays visual ward layout with bed statuses: 'Available', 'Occupied', 'Cleaning'.
AC2: System prevents assigning occupied or uncleaned beds.
AC3: Selected bed is reserved and linked to the active inpatient admission record.

stories.user_story: As a Nurse, I want to record patient bed or ward transfers with transfer reasons and timestamps, so that patient physical location and differential room rates are tracked accurately.
stories.capability: record patient bed or ward transfers with transfer reasons and timestamps
stories.business_value: Maintains accurate clinical location tracking and differential room billing calculations.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Form accepts origin bed, destination bed, transfer reason, and transfer timestamp.
AC2: Origin bed is released to 'Cleaning' and destination bed marked 'Occupied'.
AC3: Transfer history is logged in the admission chart for billing calculation.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to authorize clinical discharge and author a structured discharge summary, so that inpatient treatment is formally closed and final billing can proceed.
stories.capability: authorize clinical discharge and author a structured discharge summary
stories.business_value: Ensures proper medical sign-off and patient handover instructions prior to discharge.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Doctor enters final diagnosis, clinical course, condition at discharge, and follow-up advice.
AC2: Bed status transitions to vacated and queued for sanitization.
AC3: System locks clinical ordering and notifies the billing desk for final reconciliation.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to record chief complaints, clinical observations, diagnoses, and treatment plans during consultations, so that a complete encounter record is documented.
stories.capability: record chief complaints, clinical observations, diagnoses, and treatment plans during consultations
stories.business_value: Maintains an accurate, legally compliant medical record for every clinical visit.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Clinical form captures chief complaints, history of present illness, and ICD diagnoses.
AC2: Clinical notes are permanently timestamped and digitally attributed to the doctor.
AC3: Saved encounter notes are immediately accessible in the patient's EMR timeline.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to record known patient allergies and have the system warn me if I prescribe a contraindicated drug, so that adverse drug reactions are prevented.
stories.capability: record known patient allergies and have the system warn me if I prescribe a contraindicated drug
stories.business_value: Eliminates preventable prescription errors and protects patient safety.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Captures allergen name, reaction severity (Mild, Moderate, Severe), and date observed.
AC2: Displays high-visibility allergy badge on the patient chart header.
AC3: System triggers an audible/visual warning if a prescribed drug conflicts with documented allergies.

stories.user_story: As a Nurse, I want to record patient vital signs (BP, heart rate, temperature, SpO2) and nursing notes, so that patient physiological status is tracked continuously.
stories.capability: record patient vital signs (BP, heart rate, temperature, SpO2) and nursing notes
stories.business_value: Enables timely detection of patient clinical deterioration.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Form accepts standard numeric vital readings for BP, Pulse, Temperature, SpO2, and Resp Rate.
AC2: Readings outside standard physiological ranges are highlighted in red.
AC3: Chronological vitals trend chart is rendered in the patient chart.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to view an integrated chronological timeline of all past consultations, admissions, lab results, and medications, so that I have complete historical context.
stories.capability: view an integrated chronological timeline of all past consultations, admissions, lab results, and medications
stories.business_value: Provides longitudinal medical context for accurate clinical decision-making.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Timeline displays chronological visits, admissions, procedures, and tests.
AC2: Quick filters allow narrowing history by encounter type, date range, or specialty.
AC3: Past clinical entries are strictly read-only to preserve legal integrity.

stories.user_story: As a Doctor, I want to order diagnostic laboratory tests from the clinical encounter screen, so that the laboratory receives structured diagnostic test orders.
stories.capability: order diagnostic laboratory tests from the clinical encounter screen
stories.business_value: Eliminates paper lab slips and accelerates diagnostic turnaround times.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Doctor selects investigations from the hospital's standardized laboratory test catalog.
AC2: Order captures clinical indication, urgency (Routine / Stat), and ordering physician ID.
AC3: Order is dispatched instantly to the laboratory technician worklist.

stories.user_story: As a Lab Technician, I want to record specimen collection and enter test findings against standard reference ranges, so that diagnostic results are validated.
stories.capability: record specimen collection and enter test findings against standard reference ranges
stories.business_value: Ensures laboratory findings are accurately recorded and abnormal values are flagged.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Technician logs specimen barcode ID, collection timestamp, and sample condition.
AC2: Form accepts quantitative findings and automatically highlights out-of-range values.
AC3: Result entry requires technician sign-off before report generation.

stories.user_story: As a Lab Technician, I want to publish finalized diagnostic lab reports to the patient chart and portal, so that physicians and patients can review test outcomes.
stories.capability: publish finalized diagnostic lab reports to the patient chart and portal
stories.business_value: Provides immediate electronic access to verified diagnostic findings.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Lab technician signs off and finalizes the diagnostic report.
AC2: Finalized report is published immediately to the patient chart and patient portal.
AC3: System generates printable PDF lab reports with hospital letterhead and reference ranges.

stories.user_story: As a Pharmacist, I want to view electronic prescriptions and dispense prescribed medications with verified dosage instructions, so that patients receive correct medications.
stories.capability: view electronic prescriptions and dispense prescribed medications with verified dosage instructions
stories.business_value: Eliminates prescription transcription errors and verifies medication safety.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Pharmacist queue displays pending prescriptions with patient name, medicine, dosage, and duration.
AC2: Pharmacist verifies dosage and flags any dispensing notes.
AC3: Confirming dispensing updates prescription status to 'Dispensed'.

stories.user_story: As a Pharmacist, I want medicine inventory stock quantities to automatically decrement upon dispensing, so that stock records reflect live availability.
stories.capability: medicine inventory stock quantities to automatically decrement upon dispensing
stories.business_value: Prevents inventory discrepancies and manual stock ledger reconciliations.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Dispensing confirmation immediately deducts dispensed unit counts from the inventory database.
AC2: System blocks dispensing if requested count exceeds available physical stock.
AC3: Every stock decrement is logged with timestamp, prescription ID, and pharmacist ID.

stories.user_story: As a Pharmacist, I want to track medicine batch numbers and expiration dates with automated expiry warnings, so that expired medicines are never dispensed.
stories.capability: track medicine batch numbers and expiration dates with automated expiry warnings
stories.business_value: Protects patient health by enforcing First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) dispensing rules.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Stock records track batch number, manufacturing date, and expiry date for each drug.
AC2: Dashboard displays active alerts for batches expiring within 30, 60, and 90 days.
AC3: System strictly blocks selection of expired batches during prescription fulfillment.

stories.user_story: As a Pharmacist, I want to receive automated low-stock threshold alerts and generate replenishment lists, so that essential medicines never stock out.
stories.capability: receive automated low-stock threshold alerts and generate replenishment lists
stories.business_value: Guarantees continuous availability of life-saving pharmaceutical supplies.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Minimum reorder threshold quantities can be configured per medicine.
AC2: System alerts pharmacist when stock dips below minimum reorder level.
AC3: Generates exportable purchase requisition lists for depleted inventory items.

stories.user_story: As an Accountant, I want to generate itemized invoices for outpatient consultations, lab tests, and pharmacy orders, so that outpatient revenue is billed accurately.
stories.capability: generate itemized invoices for outpatient consultations, lab tests, and pharmacy orders
stories.business_value: Ensures rapid, transparent billing collection at outpatient points of service.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: System auto-populates billing line items from consultation fees, lab orders, and pharmacy issues.
AC2: Accountant can apply authorized discounts and select payment modes (Cash / Card / Digital).
AC3: Invoice generation updates balance due and issues an official invoice number.

stories.user_story: As an Accountant, I want to consolidate room stay charges, doctor rounds, procedures, tests, and medications into a final inpatient invoice upon discharge, so that revenue is reconciled.
stories.capability: consolidate room stay charges, doctor rounds, procedures, tests, and medications into a final inpatient invoice upon discharge
stories.business_value: Eliminates unbilled inpatient hospital services upon patient discharge.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Calculates room/bed charges based on stay duration and bed transfer history.
AC2: Aggregates all clinical procedures, investigations, nursing charges, and medications.
AC3: Reconciles advance deposits against final total balance before discharge clearance.

stories.user_story: As an Accountant, I want to record patient insurance policy details, verify coverage, and track insurance claim settlements, so that co-pays and insurance balances are split correctly.
stories.capability: record patient insurance policy details, verify coverage, and track insurance claim settlements
stories.business_value: Accelerates insurance claim reimbursement and clarifies patient out-of-pocket costs.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Form captures insurance provider, policy number, pre-authorization code, and co-pay %.
AC2: System splits final invoice into patient payable portion and insurer claim amount.
AC3: Tracks claim status transitions: 'Submitted' → 'Approved' → 'Settled' → 'Rejected'.

stories.user_story: As an Accountant, I want to generate official payment receipts and review past billing transaction histories, so that financial transactions are auditable.
stories.capability: generate official payment receipts and review past billing transaction histories
stories.business_value: Provides patients with proof of payment and maintains auditable transaction records.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: System prints official receipt with receipt number, payment mode, tax breakdown, and cashier name.
AC2: Patients can view and download all past receipts from the patient portal.
AC3: Maintains immutable payment transaction logs that cannot be modified.

stories.user_story: As an Accountant, I want to record and categorize hospital operational expenses (utilities, supplier bills, maintenance), so that hospital cash outflows are tracked.
stories.capability: record and categorize hospital operational expenses (utilities, supplier bills, maintenance)
stories.business_value: Provides comprehensive financial oversight over hospital operational expenses.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Form records expense category, vendor name, invoice reference, payment date, and amount.
AC2: Requires administrative approval for expense vouchers exceeding threshold limits.
AC3: Generates monthly hospital operational expenditure summary reports.

stories.user_story: As an Admin, I want to manage staff profiles, department assignments, and job designations, so that hospital human resource records are organized.
stories.capability: manage staff profiles, department assignments, and job designations
stories.business_value: Establishes clean organizational directory for clinical and administrative staff.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Admin can create, view, update, and deactivate employee records.
AC2: Assigns staff members to clinical, nursing, pharmacy, lab, or administrative departments.
AC3: Staff directory is searchable by name, designation, and department.

stories.user_story: As an Admin, I want to track non-pharmacy hospital equipment, medical consumables, and purchase requisitions, so that hospital equipment is maintained.
stories.capability: track non-pharmacy hospital equipment, medical consumables, and purchase requisitions
stories.business_value: Ensures non-pharmacy consumables and biomedical equipment are replenished on schedule.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Tracks hospital physical assets, serial numbers, maintenance schedules, and consumable levels.
AC2: Department heads can submit purchase requests for supplies.
AC3: Admin can review and approve purchase orders.

stories.user_story: As an Admin, I want to enforce role-based access control, secure authentication, password encryption, and session management, so that medical and financial records are protected.
stories.capability: enforce role-based access control, secure authentication, password encryption, and session management
stories.business_value: Protects sensitive patient data and enforces least-privilege security principles.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: System enforces role permissions for Admin, Doctor, Nurse, Receptionist, Pharmacist, Lab Tech, Accountant, and Patient.
AC2: Passwords are encrypted using modern hashing algorithms and authenticated with secure session tokens.
AC3: Unauthorized API requests are blocked with HTTP 401/403 status codes.

stories.user_story: As an Admin, I want to review comprehensive, immutable audit logs of user logins, medical record views, prescriptions, and billing actions, so that hospital activities are accountable.
stories.capability: review comprehensive, immutable audit logs of user logins, medical record views, prescriptions, and billing actions
stories.business_value: Enforces institutional accountability and satisfies regulatory compliance standards.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: System logs timestamp, user ID, role, action type, resource ID, and client IP address.
AC2: Audit logs are append-only and protected against modification or deletion.
AC3: Admin can filter audit logs by date range, user, action, and module.

stories.user_story: As an Admin, I want the system to enforce data validation, automated error logging, and regular database backups, so that system stability and data integrity are maintained.
stories.capability: the system to enforce data validation, automated error logging, and regular database backups
stories.business_value: Guarantees platform resilience, data preservation, and rapid disaster recovery.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Server-side validation rejects malformed payloads with descriptive error responses.
AC2: Unhandled exceptions are logged with stack traces for engineering diagnosis.
AC3: Automated daily database backup routines execute and verify archive integrity.

stories.user_story: As an Admin, I want to view executive dashboards, generate hospital reports, search across modules, and receive alert notifications, so that management has actionable operational intelligence.
stories.capability: view executive dashboards, generate hospital reports, search across modules, and receive alert notifications
stories.business_value: Provides executive visibility across clinical occupancy, operational revenue, and hospital throughput.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Executive dashboard visualizes bed occupancy rates, revenue metrics, and patient visit volumes.
AC2: Global search allows multi-criteria filtering across patients, staff, invoices, and lab tests.
AC3: Automated notifications alert users to appointment bookings, critical lab findings, and stock thresholds.
